reason: In a normal week without deadline panic, I am not paying ₹12,990 upfront for software when my article clerks rotate every two to three years and training them feels like a waste of time. I would rather test the free pilot on a couple of filings to see if the checklists actually enforce maker-checker discipline without extra overhead.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time unless the checklists truly require zero onboarding.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a fresh article clerk complete an AOC-4 or Tax Audit filing checklist on the free pilot without needing any training or handholding from me.
